summary.en: The disclosed pipeline is narrow at the asset level: fertility lifecycle development and expanded uro-oncology uses dominate. Ferring is shifting toward externally sourced innovation.
summary.zh: 已披露的管线在资产层面较窄:以生育领域的生命周期开发和泌尿肿瘤适应症拓展为主。Ferring 正转向外部来源的创新。

ind.en: Intermediate-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer; Japan high-grade disease, earlier upper-tract disease
ind.zh: 中危非肌层浸润性膀胱癌;日本高级别疾病,较早期上尿路疾病
中国的控制性卵巢刺激

watch.en: Menopur reached €1 billion sales in 2025; fertility remains commercially central.
watch.zh: Menopur 2025 年销售额达到 €1 billion;生育领域仍是商业核心。

watch.en: September 2025 strategy shifted from internal discovery to external innovation.
watch.zh: 2025 年 9 月,战略由内部发现转向外部创新。

watch.en: ABLE-32 tests an intermediate-risk bladder-cancer expansion.
watch.zh: ABLE-32 试验中危膀胱癌适应症的拓展。

watch.en: 2025 net income fell to €46 million, with higher financing costs among the drivers.
watch.zh: 2025 年净利润降至 €46 million,融资成本上升是原因之一。

gaps: Only two distinct assets retained after excluding approved uses, completed/discontinued studies and Phase 4; regional pipeline pages appear stale.
Annual report is March 2026, older than June 2026; no newer interim financial release located.
Origins, molecular mechanisms, follitropin modality and next milestone dates were not verified; phase counts not published in reviewed sources.
Global pipeline lists CELESTIAL studies without termination status; annual report says discontinued in 2025, so excluded.
The annual-report URL was replaced with the working PDF linked from the company March 10, 2026 results release (the obsolete /sites/16/ path was removed).
